[quote=yzakastan;61444840][b]March 14, 2028: The Femboy Question is Finally Answered[/b]
Well I want to congratulate you your honour, declared Cahit as he rolled into the office of the Shah, We have the necessary votes to ensure that the Femboy ideology is dealt with, the mullahs will thank you for centuries! declared Cahit with a joyous spreading of his hands, leaning slightly forward in his wheelchair.
It was a necessary step to regional security, and I am aware that security has become a big question, especially with the recent issues along the strait, there are rumors of terrorism arising once more in the South west of the shamats, it is easy to convince the party to lean one way if a policy is worded correctly, replied the Shah with a grim smile.
And you did it perfectly, intoned Cahit. I assume you will be meeting my counterpart in the Senate also? asked Cahit.
I will, at least I intend to, replied the shah.
Well, give him my best, replied Cahit, leaning forward once more before bidding the Shah adieu.

In the meantime, the Senate had convened to discuss the new bill which sat at them, it was a war powers resolution, a rare sight in the Senate, indeed once every decade an attempt would be made by some nationalist faction to get the nation to declare jihad or some other form of war in otrder to reclaim the title of Golden Caliphate, but those usually died quickly at the hand of the Shah, so it was odd to see the bill now laid out on the table.
The Chamber has requested that we speed this through, gentlemen, began Edis gravely.
I should wonder how they did so, chortled one of the Senators, slapping the table with his hand.
Edis frowned, It is now up to us, gentlemen, whether we allow thisshift, he intoned with a stern nod, Vote according to the national mandate, 
With that, 21 votes would be cast, 15 in favor of the passage of the mandate, 6 against. The bill to declare the Femboy threat a formal threat to the interests of Yzakastan would pass to a national referendum.
